props.sub: A summer speed camp for high school athletes at Meridian Performance, 4th Street North at 22nd Avenue. Sprint mechanics, acceleration and change of direction, three mornings a week, in groups of no more than eight. $449 for the block, registration closes June 2.
props.headline: Twelve sessions. Two timed tests. Four weeks.

props.intro: Speed is a skill. Everything below is coachable in four weeks.

items.body: Start position, shin angle and ground contact, drilled until they hold up at full speed. Acceleration is where games are won.
items.title: First-step mechanics

items.body: Decelerate, plant and go again without losing the ball or the ankle. Change-of-direction work in every session.
items.title: Cuts you can trust

items.body: Timed 10 and 40, broad jump and a change-of-direction test, week one and week four, side by side.

props.heading: One price, everything included
props.footnote: Spots are limited by group size. Ask about sibling and team rates when you sign up.

items.a: The first session is Monday June 9 and registration closes June 2, or earlier if the groups fill. Later four-week blocks run through August — ask and we'll tell you what's open.
items.q: When does the camp start and when do we need to register?

items.a: High school athletes, roughly rising 9th through 12th grade. Groups are set by age and training age, so a rising freshman is never training alongside a senior.
items.q: What ages is the camp for?

items.a: Three mornings a week for four weeks. Pick your preferred morning slot on the form and we'll confirm a group time that fits.

Full refund if you cancel seven or more days before the first session. Inside seven days, or after the block starts, we don't refund — but if your athlete is injured mid-block we'll carry the unused sessions to the next camp.
items.q: What if we cancel, or my athlete gets injured?

items.a: Tell us in advance and we'll slot your athlete into another group that week where there's room. Missed sessions aren't credited, but we'd rather move you than lose you.
items.q: What if we miss a session?

items.a: No. The block is built around mechanics, and the athletes who start furthest from clean technique usually move their numbers most.
items.q: Does my athlete need to be fast already?

items.a: Let us know on the form. If your athlete is cleared for sport we can coach around most things; if they're mid-rehab we'll tell you honestly whether to wait.
Nothing is due on this form. We confirm a group time first, then send payment details and the full schedule.
